item.title: Governor Reynolds says she has settled on the level of funding growth for Iowa’s public schools
item.description: Governor Reynolds says she has settled on the level of funding growth for Iowa’s public schools. Although inflation nationwide stands at 2.7 percent, Reynolds’ plan would raise per-student funding by 2 percent for the 2026–27 academic year.
